mentions.name: Spore Intel
mentions.description: This tool makes it simple to run open-weight AI models on your own hardware and access them privately from anywhere. It also lets users share their compute with others through a built-in credit system.
mentions.problem: Running open-weight models on personal hardware and accessing them privately from anywhere is not simple.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Spore Intel - https://sporeintel.com/

Working on this tool to make running open-weight models on your hardware and accessing them from anywhere privately simple. Also has the option of sharing your compute with others with the built in credit system.
mentions.author: chrisischris
